lines.zh: 我走在离你二十格的地方
lines.en: I keep twenty blocks between your back and me.
You stop; I stop.
My footsteps fall out of step with yours.
I travel along the treeline.
You walk in the open; I walk in shadow.
The stones below the slope hide me.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的火把走了一夜
lines.en: I followed your torch all night.
I leave no prints on the snow.

lines.zh: 这个形态走路没有重量
lines.en: This form walks without any weight.
You enter the cave; I wait at its mouth.
I stand far off and do not intrude.

lines.zh: 你的营地亮着，我数火苗
lines.en: Your camp is lit; I count the flames.
All day I watch only your smoke.

lines.zh: 我靠在树上，和树一样高
lines.en: I lean on a tree, as tall as it.
A bird lands on my shoulder and leaves.

lines.zh: 一千零二十四点生命，很安静
lines.en: One thousand and twenty-four health, perfectly quiet.
A hundred armor plates would clatter if touched.
I do not enter camps; that is the rule.
I am waiting for you to forget me.
The night wind comes from your direction.
I have counted the pegs of your tent.
These ruts in the road were worn by me.
You are eating; I can smell it.
Do not look for me; I am always here.

lines.zh: 我数你篝火的柴，一根不差
lines.en: I count the logs in your fire, none missed.

lines.zh: 影子拉长时，我换一条腿站
lines.en: When the shadow lengthens, I shift to the other leg.
You found me; that is not so bad.
I stand here; come closer if you like.
My face is turned toward you.
You look at me, and I do not hide.

lines.zh: 二十格是我们该有的距离
lines.en: Twenty blocks is the distance we should keep.
You waved; I did not wave back.
At this distance I see you clearly.
Your eyes are searching for me.
I am in the trees; do not run over.
You raise your bow; I step back half a pace.
Looking at me is enough.
I will not take the first step.
I lean against that tree behind you.
You walked faster today than yesterday.

lines.zh: 你抬头正好，我在树杈间
lines.en: You looked up at the right moment; I am between the branches.
Your arrow grazed my shoulder.

lines.zh: 一千零二十四点生命，还早
lines.en: One thousand and twenty-four health; it is early.
I will retreat, but not far.

lines.zh: 百层护甲替我吃了一剑
lines.en: A hundred plates took that sword for me.

lines.zh: 你打中我，就等于看见我
lines.en: Hitting me means you have seen me.
Pain makes me remember the path better.
I withdraw beyond twenty blocks.
Do not follow me, and do not shout.
I will remember this sword stroke.

lines.zh: 你赢了这一下，不是这一夜
lines.en: You won this exchange, not this night.
You hold out food; I step back.
Feeding me will only send me farther off.
I do not eat; I follow.
You set the bread down on the ground.

lines.zh: 那一点香味到不了我这
lines.en: That little smell does not reach me here.
I keep my distance on purpose.
I have seen your good intentions.
Do not come near; the distance would vanish.
Keep the food there in your hand.
I only want to watch you eat.
I was surprised when you bumped into me.
This form grows warm at close range.
You back away, and I retreat at once.
We were not meant to touch.
Your shoulder met my armor plate.
One touch shortened the gap by ten blocks.
I stay where I am, unmoving.
Do not bump into me again.
You smell of rust and old iron.
Step back three paces; I will forget it.
A stalker takes no companion.
I have followed you for a whole season.
Kin would stare at each other till dawn.
My place is behind you.
No one is willing to walk beside me.
Distance is my only friend.
Two shadows would be too heavy.
I am used to watching fires alone.
Do not go looking for another one.
There are only the two of us on this road.
Your things fell right beside my feet.
I do not pick them up; I keep watch over them.
That iron looks grey in the grass.
Dropped is dropped; do not come back.
My hands do not touch your belongings.
The bread rolled down the slope.
Turn back and pick it up; I will wait.
These have lain here a long time.
I never touch another's belongings.
Dropped things will draw others here.

lines.zh: 你走出村子，我就记住了
lines.en: The moment you left the village, I remembered you.
My hands stay still until the watching is finished.

lines.zh: 一千零二十四点生命，够我耐心
lines.en: One thousand and twenty-four health gives me patience.

lines.zh: 百层护甲，远看像一件斗篷
lines.en: A hundred plates look like a cloak from afar.
You noticed me; the plan has changed.
I have drawn your route in my mind.
I do not steal prey; I only follow.

lines.zh: 从山坡到河边，我都记着
lines.en: From the hillside to the river, I remember all.
You will not make it home tonight.

lines.zh: 我选你，因为你不看后面
lines.en: I chose you because you never look back.

lines.zh: 火光之外都是我的地方
lines.en: Everything beyond the firelight is mine.
The longer you linger, the closer I come.
Do not shout; no one will hear you.
You are already marked along this road.

lines.zh: 你捡起那块铁，我改主意了
lines.en: You picked up that iron; I changed my mind.
I have said your name three times.

lines.zh: 从今天起，你走哪我跟哪
lines.en: From today, wherever you walk, I follow.
I have your bootsteps memorized.
I am half a mile behind you.
You speed up; I speed up a little.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我刚好进树影
lines.en: You look back; I slip into the shadows.
Twenty blocks, not a single step more.
You stop at the river; so do I.
I make no sound; the trees speak for me.

lines.zh: 你跑向村庄，我绕到前面
lines.en: You run for the village; I circle ahead.

lines.zh: 你借宿的那家，我在窗外
lines.en: The house you sleep in; I am outside its window.

lines.zh: 距离缩到十格时我就撤
lines.en: At ten blocks I will pull back again.
Listen; the snow is creaking.
I never quite catch up with you.
Your route has circled three times.
I keep watch over these woods at night.
When you fall asleep, I will come closer.
You slipped once on the snow slope.
I have circled upwind of you.
Your torch has burned down a notch.

lines.zh: 数到十，我就跟你换位置
lines.en: Count to ten and I trade places with you.

lines.zh: 你在岔口犹豫，我选好了
lines.en: You hesitate at the fork; I have chosen.
My steps are lighter than the snow.
You forced me close; so be it.

lines.zh: 这一下我只用了一半力
lines.en: I used only half my strength here.
I do not like being this close.

lines.zh: 你打到我了，距离也没了
lines.en: You hit me, and the distance is gone too.

lines.zh: 我从坡上下来，只用三步
lines.en: I came down the slope in three steps.
You hold your shield too low.
When it is done, I withdraw to the treeline.
Do not chase; I will not stop.
You have a new cut on you now.
I do not look at faces when I strike.
This slap is a warning.
You backed off; good.
Next time I will come even closer.

lines.zh: 血的味道让跟踪变简单
lines.en: The smell of blood makes tracking easier.

lines.zh: 你进林子时我就已经在了
lines.en: I was already here when you entered.

lines.zh: 黄昏之后我从坡上下来
lines.en: After dusk I come down the slope.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸和风一个节奏
lines.en: My breathing keeps the rhythm of the wind.

lines.zh: 一千零二十四点生命慢慢显形
lines.en: One thousand and twenty-four health shows up slowly.

lines.zh: 百层护甲在月光下有影子
lines.en: A hundred plates cast a shadow in the moonlight.
Something stirs behind the tree; then me.
I come from the direction you never take.
The fog sits low; I stand tall.
The fire you lit drew me here.
I know this forest very well.
You see the shadow first, then the face.
I am not in a hurry; I arrived early.

lines.zh: 你身后那条路已经封了
lines.en: That road behind you is already closed.
Tonight I will watch from a distance.
While you pitched your tent, I watched.

lines.zh: 月亮升到树梢，我站起来
lines.en: When the moon cleared the treetops, I stood.

lines.zh: 我从另一边的坡上来了
lines.en: I came up the slope on the other side.
The second birdsong tonight was mine.

lines.zh: 露水落到我身上，我不动
lines.en: Dew settles on me; I do not move.
When the fire dies, the shadows are mine.
The fire spreads; I retreat to the stream.
I slid down the slope and caught myself.
I close my eyes underwater.
The blast travels faster than I do.
An arrow stuck in my shoulder; I pulled it out.
The spell leaves letters on my armor.
I do not eat, and I do not die.
The lightning struck just behind my left.
Falling into the void, I still watch you.
